Aberration.notes: Stackable stairs have inner and outer corners, allowing pyramid style stairs. Stairs actually look like smooth slopes, but can be considered normal stairs.

Burrow.notes: Corner tile is 2×2; only one corner tile exists. Inner corner is a full 1×1 tile, not a quadrant filler.

stairs.name: castle wall corner 2x2 curved w step
castle wall corner 2x2 base curved w step

CastleRuins.notes: Pillars can be created of custom height by using the base (1.0h), any number of mid (0.5h), and a top (0.5h) piece. No inner corner in set - consider using Abandoned Village, or leaving blank.

Cavern.notes: There are only 2x2 tiles for walls and corners. There are no inner corners, but placing 2x2 corners can make this look convincing.

CobbleStones.notes: There are no wall tiles, only floor. Corner tiles are named so because of a stone pattern on the floor.

Desert Village.notes: Desert floor 01 matches wall texture. Desert floor 03 matches roof texture.

Harbor.notes: All harbor tiles are raised 1.0 from the base, but walls are much shorter than normal. It doesn't ever make sense to have levels above the first, so minCeilingHeight is left null.

Library Set.notes: Prop-only tileset (bookcases and shelves). No structural tiles.

Marble Palace.notes: Stackable stairs have inner and outer corners, allowing pyramid style stairs.

Merchant.notes: Only useful as part of other scenes. No floor tiles.

Moorgoth.notes: Large walls are twice as tall as normal walls, but do not have integrated floor.

Nature.notes: No walls or stairs. Only suitable for outdoor scenes. Elevation changes are accomplished with slope tiles.

Palisade.notes: Only useful as part of other scenes. No floor tiles.

Ruined Temple.notes: Only floor and stair tiles. Only really useful in combination with other scenes.

Rural.notes: Stairs are stackable, but without blocks. Build as a ramp without support.

Sewers.rotationQuirks: All tiles must be rotated 45° clockwise to align with other tilesets.
Sewers.notes: Inner corners are full tiles, not quadrants. Regular doors don't fit well - use the special sewer door, which is 2x1, and insert the compatible door inside the wall to make it look right; this means that corridors must be at least 2 wide to use doors. There are no stairs, but a special wall tile with a ladder exists (7e307597-48d3-4c6d-9f1c-ac53830f74ac), which could lead to a hole in the floor above.

Ship.notes: Ignore for now. Too complex and not useful for our purposes.

TempWater.notes: Two water prop tiles only (1x1 and 2x2). Not a structural tileset.

Street.notes: Road and sidewalk props only. No structural elements.
